# homarr_boards (Data Source)

Lists every Homarr board visible to the configured API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "homarr_boards" "all" {}

output "public_boards" {
  value = [for board in data.homarr_boards.all.boards : board.name if board.is_public]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `boards` (Attributes List) All boards, in the order Homarr returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--boards))

<a id="nestedatt--boards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `boards`

Read-Only:

- `creator_id` (String) Identifier of the board's creator.
- `creator_name` (String) Name of the board's creator.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the board.
- `is_home` (Boolean) Whether this is the home board of the user behind the API key.
- `is_mobile_home` (Boolean) Whether this is the mobile home board of the user behind the API key.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the board is visible without authentication.
- `logo_image_url` (String) Board logo URL.
- `name` (String) Name of the board.
